2:  * Fused Attention CUDA kernel — optimized implementation
3:  *
4:  * Computes: output = softmax(Q @ K^T / sqrt(d)) @ V
5:  * with causal masking support.

7:  * Optimizations over baseline:

9:  * - Vectorized dot products where possible
10:  */

13: #include <cuda_runtime.h>
14: #include <cuda_fp16.h>
15: #include <math.h>
16: #include <float.h>

18: template <typename scalar_t>
19: __global__ void attention_kernel(
20:     const scalar_t* __restrict__ Q,    // [B, H, N_q, D]
21:     const scalar_t* __restrict__ K,    // [B, H, N_kv, D]
22:     const scalar_t* __restrict__ V,    // [B, H, N_kv, D]
23:     scalar_t* __restrict__ output,     // [B, H, N_q, D]
24:     int q_len,
25:     int kv_len,
26:     int head_dim,
27:     float scale,
28:     bool causal

31:     int h = blockIdx.y;
32:     int q_pos = blockIdx.z;
33: 
34:     int num_heads = gridDim.y;
35:     int q_BH_stride = q_len * head_dim;
36:     int kv_BH_stride = kv_len * head_dim;
37:     int base_q = (b * num_heads + h) * q_BH_stride + q_pos * head_dim;
38:     int full_q_pos = kv_len - q_len + q_pos;
39: 
40:     extern __shared__ float smem[];
41:     float* scores = smem;  // [kv_len]
42:     // Load Q row into shared memory after scores area
43:     float* s_q = smem + kv_len;  // [head_dim]
44: 
45:     int tid = threadIdx.x;
46:     int bdim = blockDim.x;
47: 
48:     // Cooperatively load Q into shared memory
49:     for (int d = tid; d < head_dim; d += bdim) {
50:         s_q[d] = static_cast<float>(Q[base_q + d]);
51:     }
52:     __syncthreads();
53: 
54:     // Step 1: compute attention scores + local max
55:     float local_max = -FLT_MAX;
56:     for (int j = tid; j < kv_len; j += bdim) {
57:         if (causal && j > full_q_pos) {
58:             scores[j] = -FLT_MAX;
59:         } else {
60:             float dot = 0.0f;
61:             int base_k = (b * num_heads + h) * kv_BH_stride + j * head_dim;
62:             for (int d = 0; d < head_dim; d++) {
63:                 dot += s_q[d] * static_cast<float>(__ldg(&K[base_k + d]));
64:             }
65:             scores[j] = dot * scale;
66:         }
67:         local_max = fmaxf(local_max, scores[j]);
68:     }
69: 
70:     // Parallel max reduction (warp shuffle + shared memory)
71:     for (int offset = warpSize / 2; offset > 0; offset >>= 1)
72:         local_max = fmaxf(local_max, __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffff, local_max, offset));

78:     int num_warps = (bdim + 31) >> 5;

88:         if (lane == 0) warp_reduce[0] = val;
89:     }
90:     __syncthreads();
91:     global_max = warp_reduce[0];

95:     for (int j = tid; j < kv_len; j += bdim) {
96:         float e = expf(scores[j] - global_max);

98:         local_sum += e;

100: 
101:     // Parallel sum reduction
102:     for (int offset = warpSize / 2; offset > 0; offset >>= 1)
103:         local_sum += __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffff, local_sum, offset);
104: 
105:     if (lane == 0) warp_reduce[warp_id] = local_sum;
106:     __syncthreads();
107: 
108:     float global_sum;
109:     if (warp_id == 0) {
110:         float val = (lane < num_warps) ? warp_reduce[lane] : 0.0f;
111:         for (int offset = warpSize / 2; offset > 0; offset >>= 1)

113:         if (lane == 0) warp_reduce[0] = val;
114:     }
115:     __syncthreads();
116:     global_sum = warp_reduce[0];
117: 
118:     // Normalize scores

120:     for (int j = tid; j < kv_len; j += bdim) {

128:         for (int j = 0; j < kv_len; j++) {

133:     }

1: /*
2:  * Fused SwiGLU MLP CUDA kernel — optimized implementation
3:  *
4:  * Uses cuBLAS (via torch::matmul) for the heavy GEMM work,
5:  * then fuses the SiLU activation + elementwise multiply in-place.
6:  */
7: 
8: #include <torch/extension.h>
9: #include <cuda_runtime.h>
10: #include <cuda_fp16.h>
11: #include <math.h>
12: 
13: // In-place fused SiLU-multiply: gate[i] = silu(gate[i]) * up[i]
14: // 4 elements per thread for better ILP
15: template <typename scalar_t>
16: __global__ void fused_silu_mul_inplace_kernel(
17:     scalar_t* __restrict__ gate,         // [N] - modified in place
18:     const scalar_t* __restrict__ up,     // [N]
19:     int N
20: ) {
21:     int base_idx = (blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x) * 4;
22:     #pragma unroll
23:     for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
24:         int idx = base_idx + i;
25:         if (idx < N) {
26:             float g = static_cast<float>(gate[idx]);
27:             float u = static_cast<float>(up[idx]);
28:             float silu_g = g / (1.0f + expf(-g));
29:             gate[idx] = static_cast<scalar_t>(silu_g * u);
30:         }
31:     }
32: }
33: 
34: // ─── Host wrapper ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
35: 
36: torch::Tensor agent_fused_mlp(
37:     torch::Tensor input,        // [batch, hidden]
38:     torch::Tensor gate_weight,  // [intermediate, hidden]
39:     torch::Tensor up_weight     // [intermediate, hidden]
40: ) {
41:     // Use torch matmul (cuBLAS) for the GEMMs
42:     auto gate_proj = torch::mm(input, gate_weight.t());
43:     auto up_proj = torch::mm(input, up_weight.t());
44: 
45:     int N = gate_proj.numel();
46: 
47:     int threads = 256;
48:     int blocks = (N + threads * 4 - 1) / (threads * 4);
49: 
50:     AT_DISPATCH_FLOATING_TYPES_AND2(
51:         at::ScalarType::Half, at::ScalarType::BFloat16,
52:         input.scalar_type(), "fused_mlp", [&] {
53:             fused_silu_mul_inplace_kernel<scalar_t><<<blocks, threads>>>(
54:                 gate_proj.data_ptr<scalar_t>(),
55:                 up_proj.data_ptr<scalar_t>(),
56:                 N
57:             );
58:         }
59:     );
60: 
61:     return gate_proj;  // modified in-place, no extra allocation
62: }

2:  * RMSNorm CUDA kernel — optimized implementation
3:  *
4:  * Computes: output = (x / rms(x)) * weight
5:  * where rms(x) = sqrt(mean(x^2) + eps)
6:  */
7: 
8: #include <torch/extension.h>
9: #include <cuda_runtime.h>
10: #include <cuda_fp16.h>
11: #include <math.h>
12: 
13: template <typename scalar_t>
14: __global__ __launch_bounds__(1024)
15: void rmsnorm_kernel(
16:     const scalar_t* __restrict__ input,
17:     const scalar_t* __restrict__ weight,
18:     scalar_t* __restrict__ output,
19:     int hidden_size,
20:     float eps
21: ) {
22:     int row = blockIdx.x;
23:     const scalar_t* x = input + row * hidden_size;
24:     scalar_t* o = output + row * hidden_size;
25: 
26:     // Step 1: compute sum of squares
27:     float sum_sq = 0.0f;
28:     for (int i = threadIdx.x; i < hidden_size; i += blockDim.x) {
29:         float val = static_cast<float>(__ldg(&x[i]));
30:         sum_sq += val * val;
31:     }
32: 
33:     // Warp-level reduction
34:     for (int offset = warpSize / 2; offset > 0; offset >>= 1)
35:         sum_sq += __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffff, sum_sq, offset);
36: 
37:     __shared__ float shared[32];
38:     int lane = threadIdx.x & 31;
39:     int warp_id = threadIdx.x >> 5;
40: 
41:     if (lane == 0) shared[warp_id] = sum_sq;
42:     __syncthreads();
43: 
44:     if (warp_id == 0) {
45:         int num_warps = (blockDim.x + 31) >> 5;
46:         sum_sq = (lane < num_warps) ? shared[lane] : 0.0f;
47:         for (int offset = warpSize / 2; offset > 0; offset >>= 1)
48:             sum_sq += __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffff, sum_sq, offset);
49:     }
50: 
51:     __shared__ float s_rms_inv;
52:     if (threadIdx.x == 0) {
53:         s_rms_inv = rsqrtf(sum_sq / hidden_size + eps);

56: 
57:     float rms_inv = s_rms_inv;
58: 
59:     // Step 2: normalize and scale
60:     for (int i = threadIdx.x; i < hidden_size; i += blockDim.x) {
61:         float val = static_cast<float>(__ldg(&x[i]));
62:         float w = static_cast<float>(__ldg(&weight[i]));
63:         o[i] = static_cast<scalar_t>(val * rms_inv * w);
64:     }

1: /*
2:  * Rotary Positional Embedding (RoPE) CUDA kernel — optimized
3:  *
4:  * Optimizations:
5:  * - __sincosf for combined sin/cos (1 instruction vs 2)
6:  * - __fdividef for fast division
7:  * - __expf + __logf for fast pow replacement
8:  */
9: 
10: #include <torch/extension.h>
11: #include <cuda_runtime.h>
12: #include <cuda_fp16.h>
13: #include <math.h>
14: 
15: template <typename scalar_t>
16: __global__ void rotary_embedding_kernel(
17:     scalar_t* __restrict__ x,          // [batch, seq_len, num_heads, head_dim]
18:     const int* __restrict__ positions,  // [batch, seq_len]
19:     int seq_len,
20:     int num_heads,
21:     int head_dim,
22:     float base
23: ) {
24:     int idx = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
25:     int half_dim = head_dim / 2;
26: 
27:     int pair_idx = idx % half_dim;
28:     int tmp = idx / half_dim;
29:     int head = tmp % num_heads;
30:     int tmp2 = tmp / num_heads;
31:     int seq = tmp2 % seq_len;
32:     int batch = tmp2 / seq_len;
33: 
34:     int m = positions[batch * seq_len + seq];
35:     // Fast pow: base^(2*pair_idx/head_dim) = exp(log(base) * 2*pair_idx/head_dim)
36:     float exp_val = __expf(__logf(base) * __fdividef(2.0f * pair_idx, (float)head_dim));
37:     float theta = __fdividef(1.0f, exp_val);
38:     float angle = m * theta;
39: 
40:     float cos_val, sin_val;
41:     __sincosf(angle, &sin_val, &cos_val);
42: 
43:     int base_idx = ((batch * seq_len + seq) * num_heads + head) * head_dim;
44:     int i0 = base_idx + 2 * pair_idx;
45:     int i1 = i0 + 1;
46: 
47:     float x0 = static_cast<float>(x[i0]);
48:     float x1 = static_cast<float>(x[i1]);
49: 
50:     x[i0] = static_cast<scalar_t>(x0 * cos_val - x1 * sin_val);
51:     x[i1] = static_cast<scalar_t>(x0 * sin_val + x1 * cos_val);
52: }
